records.title: The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
records.selection_reason: A Code stored in the ACT collection; commencement differs from enactment year.

records.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 2023

records.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019

records.title: The Information Technology Act, 2000

records.title: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
records.selection_reason: Accessibility, rights and administrative duties.

records.title: The National Food Security Act, 2013

records.title: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009
records.selection_reason: School access, qualifications and exceptions.

records.title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
records.selection_reason: Access to legal services; eligibility queries.

records.title: The Indian Contract Act, 1872
records.selection_reason: Definitions, illustrations and dense cross-references.

records.title: The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
records.selection_reason: Procedural retrieval and longer structured documents.
